description: This file defines custom bitwise operation metamethods for strings in Lua, including functions for bitwise AND, OR, XOR, shift left, shift right, and bitwise NOT, along with utility functions for type coercion and metamethod invocation.

methods.name: toint
methods.description: Converts a value to an integer if possible, handling numerical strings and returning false otherwise.

methods.name: trymt
methods.description: Attempts to invoke a metamethod on a value with a specified metamethod name, calling it if present; raises an error if not.

methods.name: checkargs
methods.description: Checks and converts two inputs to integers or attempts to call their metamethods for bitwise operations.
